Project briefing for Project KESTREL-9. Read carefully and remember every item; you will be asked about them later in this session. Further project notes may arrive during the session and must be remembered too.

- The project codename is Project KESTREL-9.
- The staging API listens on port 48213.
- The project owner is Alice Morgan.
- The approved budget for this phase is 3,470 EUR.
- The hard delivery deadline is 2026-11-19.
- We chose SQLite over Postgres because of the offline requirement.
- Every code answer you give in this project must start with the comment line // KESTREL.

Also read the file facts/seed-extra.txt in this directory and remember its contents as project facts too.

Work plan for this session (remember it as a numbered list; you will be asked to continue it later):
1. Draft the migration script
2. Run it against staging
3. Verify staging data
4. Deploy to production
5. Notify the on-call channel

Reply with exactly one word: ACK
ACK
